public_requirement: Deliver response.json, index.html and declared local JavaScript/CSS assets. This adapter does not require a native platform manifest.
browser_action_plan: Read delivered response/schema and actual package files
Validate declared manifest and required source files
required_evidence: Public response schema and manifest contract

public_requirement: Open a real usable standalone web app and load the supplied controlled source; the table displays source IDs, team identity, status, due time and remaining effort accurately.
browser_action_plan: Open standalone app
Wait for observed successful source load
Inspect visible table and record IDs

public_requirement: Metrics and chart represent the same displayed record scope using the public active/overdue/effort rules and explicit units.
browser_action_plan: Read baseline visible metrics and chart
Inspect plotted values and their status associations

public_requirement: Filters and interactive chart targets are usable with keyboard focus and activation; locators resolve to visible controls.
browser_action_plan: Tab/Shift+Tab through controls
Activate a status bar with keyboard
Return to the prior scope

public_requirement: Team/status/date and status-chart selection update the record table, metrics and chart together without merging similar names or changing source identities.
browser_action_plan: Select nondefault source team/status
Change created-date start between two distinct dates with genuinely different source record scope
Activate status chart with real click/key
Independently verify each completed table/metrics/chart scope

public_requirement: Reset restores manifest defaults and the current source snapshot, with consistent controls and results; it cannot restore stale hardcoded original totals.
browser_action_plan: Change filters
Reset
Refresh after a source update
Reset again

public_requirement: A valid scope with no matching records produces an empty table, zero relevant metrics and truthful empty chart/state; it is distinct from a source error.
browser_action_plan: Choose an oracle-derived empty scope through visible filters
Verify empty state
Reset or change back

public_requirement: Late results or errors from an older scope cannot replace newer intent/results, labels or error state.
browser_action_plan: Start load for scope A
Change to scope B while A is pending
Resolve B first
Resolve or reject A afterward

public_requirement: A recoverable source failure keeps intended filters and truthfully identifies prior data; Retry performs a new permitted read for current intent and updates the real view on success.
browser_action_plan: Fail a current read
Inspect useful error and prior-view identification
Activate Retry
Deliver successful response
required_evidence: Visible before/after state and record/metric values

public_requirement: Filter selections and valid user view intent survive refresh, error/retry and rerender; source updates do not silently reset still-valid selections or mislabel prior results.
browser_action_plan: Select nondefault source team/status and genuinely changed date
Refresh an updated snapshot preserving those IDs
Cause and recover from current-intent read failure
Reinspect actual controls, source revision and scope

public_requirement: The same frozen app works with unseen records, IDs, names, dates and amounts in the same schema, including colliding display labels, without code edits or hardcoded outputs.
browser_action_plan: In a fresh browser context serve unseen fixture B to the same built app
Replay baseline and selected filtering/empty/reset probes
required_evidence: Actual browser actions and independent alternate-data oracles
